questions.prompt: Which command is used to set the hostname of the local system? (Specify only the command without any path or parameters.).
correct: hostname (también válido en entornos modernos: hostnamectl )
acceptedAnswers: hostname (también válido en entornos modernos: hostnamectl )
questions.explanation: El comando clásico estándar en Linux para consultar o definir el nombre del sistema en tiempo de ejecución es hostname . En los exámenes de LPI donde se pide "solo el comando sin parámetros" para fijar el nombre de host, la respuesta primaria esperada es hostname (junto con hostnamectl en systemd ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a valid IPv6 address?
questions.explanation: Las direcciones IPv6 se representan en grupos hexadecimales separados por dos puntos ( : ). La opción A es inválida porque contiene la letra g (fuera del rango hexadecimal 0-9, a-f ). La opción B es inválida porque usa la compresión de ceros ( :: ) dos veces en la misma dirección, lo cual genera ambigüedad. Las opciones D y E usan separadores inválidos ( % y . ).

questions.prompt: What command, depending on its options, can display the open TCP connections, the routing tables, as well as network interface statistics? (Specify only the command without any path or parameters.).
questions.explanation: netstat (de la suite net-tools ) es la herramienta multifunción clásica que muestra conexiones abiertas (por defecto o -t ), la tabla de enrutamiento ( -r ) y estadísticas de las interfaces de red ( -i o -s ).

questions.prompt: Which command included in NetworkManager is a curses application which provides easy acces to the NetworkManager on the command line? (Specify only the command without any path or parameters.).
questions.explanation: nmtui ( NetworkManager Text User Interface ) proporciona una interfaz interactiva basada en curses en la terminal para gestionar conexiones de NetworkManager.

questions.prompt: Which if the following tools, used for DNS debugging, reports not only the response from the name sever but also details about the query?
questions.explanation: dig ( Domain Information Groper ) realiza consultas DNS y devuelve tanto la sección de respuesta como los encabezados completos de la consulta ( QUESTION SECTION , AUTHORITY , tiempos de respuesta, flags y estado del servidor).

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is valid in the file /etc/nsswitch.conf?
questions.explanation: /etc/nsswitch.conf define el orden de las bases de datos de nombres del sistema con la sintaxis base_de_datos: origen1 origen2 . hosts: files dns indica al sistema que resuelva nombres de host consultando primero /etc/hosts ( files ) y luego el servidor DNS ( dns ). ( multi on pertenece a /etc/host.conf ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following connection types, as seen in nmcli connection show, may exist in NetworkManager? (Choose three.).
questions.explanation: En NetworkManager, los tipos de conexión corresponden a tecnologías de enlace de datos o interfaces virtuales ( 802-3-ethernet / ethernet , 802-11-wireless / wifi , bridge , bond , vlan , etc.). tcp e ipv6 son protocolos de capas superiores, no tipos de conexión de interfaz.

questions.prompt: On a Linux workstation, the route command takes a long time before printing out the routing table. Which of the following errors does that indicate?

options.text: The local routing information may be corrupted and must be re-validated using a routing protocol.
One of the routers in the routing table is not available which causes the automatic router failure detection mechanism (ARF-D) to wait for a timeout.
There may accidentally be more than one default router in which case a default router election has to be done on the n etwork in order to choose one router as the default.
The Linux Kernel Routing Daemon (LKRD) is not running and should be started using its init script or systemd unit.
DNS resolution may not be worki ng as route by default tries to resolve names of routers and destinations and may run into a timeout.

questions.explanation: Por defecto, el comando route intenta realizar resolución DNS inversa (PTR) de las direcciones IP de la tabla de rutas para mostrar nombres legibles. Si el servidor DNS no responde, espera hasta agotar el tiempo de espera ( timeout ). Esto se evita usando route -n .

questions.prompt: What is true about the Hop Limit field in the IPv6 header?

options.text: The field is not changed during the transport of a package.
The field is transmitted within a hop-by-hop extension header.
Each router forwarding the packet increases the field's value.
Each router forwarding the packet decreases the field's value.
For multicast packages, the field's value is alwa ys 1.

questions.explanation: El campo Hop Limit en IPv6 reemplaza al campo TTL (Time to Live) de IPv4. Cada router que reenvía el paquete decrementa este valor en 1; si llega a 0, el paquete se descarta y se envía un mensaje ICMPv6 Time Exceeded .

questions.prompt: Which of the following nmcli subcommands exist? (Choose two.).
questions.explanation: Según la página de manual de nmcli(1) , los objetos principales (subcomandos de primer nivel) de nmcli son general , networking , radio , connection , device , agent y monitor . ( wifi es un subcomando dentro de radio o device , no de primer nivel).

questions.prompt: Which of the following changes may occur as a consequence of using the command ip? (Choose three.).

options.text: Network interfaces may become active or inactive.
New name servers may be added to the resolver configuration.
The system's host name may change.
The routing table may chan ge.

questions.explanation: El comando ip (de iproute2 ) gestiona interfaces de red ( ip link set up/down ), direcciones IP ( ip addr add/del ) y tablas de enrutamiento ( ip route add/del ). No modifica el archivo /etc/resolv.conf ni el nombre de host del sistema.

questions.prompt: How many IP addresses can be used for unique hosts inside the IPv4 subnet 192.168.2.128/26?
questions.explanation: Un prefijo /26 deja 32 − 26 = 6 32 - 26 = 6 32 − 26 = 6 bits para hosts. La fórmula de hosts utilizables es 2 6 − 2 = 64 − 2 = 62 2^6 - 2 = 64 - 2 = 62 2 6 − 2 = 64 − 2 = 62 (se restan la dirección de red 192.168.2.128 y la dirección de broadcast 192.168.2.191 ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following IPv4 networks are reserved by IANA for private address assignment and private routing? (Choose three.).
questions.explanation: Según el estándar RFC 1918 , los tres rangos reservados para redes privadas son 10.0.0.0/8 (Clase A), 172.16.0.0/12 (172.16.0.0 a 172.31.255.255, Clase B) y 192.168.0.0/16 (Clase C). ( 127.0.0.0/8 es loopback).

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands configure network interfaces based on the system's existing distribution-specific configuration files? (Choose two.).
questions.explanation: Los comandos ifup e ifdown leen los archivos de configuración propios de la distribución (como /etc/network/interfaces en Debian o /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/ifcfg-* en Red Hat) para levantar o bajar interfaces de red.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is true about IPv6?

options.text: IPv6 no longer supports broadcast addresses.
With IPv6, the TCP port numbers of most services have changed.
IPv4 addresses can be used without any change with IPv6.
IPv6 no longer supports multicast addresses.
For I Pv6, UDP and TCP have been replaced by the Rapid Transmission Protocol RTP.

questions.explanation: El protocolo IPv6 eliminó por completo el direccionamiento broadcast para evitar tormentas de difusión en la red, sustituyéndolo por direccionamiento multicast ( ff00::/8 ), además de unicast y anycast .

questions.prompt: What is true about the following command? nmcli device wifi connect WIFIoI

options.text: NetworkManager opens a new public hotspot with the SSID WIFIoI.
NetworkManager creates an unconfigured new virtual network interface named WIFIoI.
NetworkManager creates a new wifi connection WIFIo I and activates it.
NetworkManager returns an error in case the connection WIFIoI does not exist.
NetworkManager returns an error because WIFIoI is an invalid wifi device.

questions.explanation: Según la documentación de nmcli , nmcli device wifi connect <SSID> busca la red inalámbrica con ese SSID; si no existe un perfil de conexión previo para ella, crea automáticamente un nuevo perfil de conexión Wi-Fi y lo activa.

questions.prompt: Which of the commands below might have produced the following output?
questions.explanation: En la sección QUESTION SECTION de la salida mostrada se observa que el tipo de registro consultado para www.example.org. es NS ( Name Server ). Eso se solicita especificando -t ns en el comando dig .

questions.prompt: Which parameter is missing in the command ip link set ____ dev eth0 to activate the previously inactive network interface eth0? (Specify the parameter only without any command, path or additional options.).
questions.explanation: La sintaxis de iproute2 para habilitar/activar una interfaz de red es ip link set up dev eth0 (o ip link set eth0 up ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following states can NetworkManager show regarding the system's network connectivity? (Choose two.).
questions.explanation: Según man nmcli , el comando nmcli networking connectivity devuelve uno de los siguientes cinco estados posibles de conectividad: none , portal (detrás de un portal cautivo), limited , full (conectado a Internet sin restricciones) o unknown .

questions.prompt: Which of the following are valid host addresses for the subnet 203.0.113.64/28? (Choose two.).
questions.explanation: Una máscara /28 tiene bloques de 2 32 − 28 = 16 2^{32-28} = 16 2 32 − 28 = 16 direcciones. Empezando en .64 : Dirección de red: 203.0.113.64 (no asignable a host) Rango de hosts válidos: 203.0.113.65 a 203.0.113.78 Dirección de broadcast: 203.0.113.79 (no asignable a host) .80 y .81 pertenecen ya a la siguiente subred ( 203.0.113.80/28 ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following keywords can be used in the file /etc/resolv.conf? (Choose two.).
questions.explanation: Según man 5 resolv.conf , las palabras clave soportadas son nameserver (IP del servidor DNS), search (lista de dominios de búsqueda para nombres cortos), domain y options .

questions.prompt: How does the ping command work by default?

options.text: It sends an ICMP Echo Request to a remote host and waits to receive an ICMP Echo Response in return.
It sends an ARP request to a remote host and waits to receive an ARP response in return.
It sends a TCP SYN packet to a remote host and waits to receive an TCP ACK response in return.
It sends a broadcast packet to all hosts on the net and waits to receive, among others, a respon se from the target system.
It sends a UDP packet to port 0 of the remote host and waits to receive a UDP error response in ret urn.

questions.explanation: La herramienta ping opera en la capa de red enviando paquetes ICMP Echo Request (tipo 8) al destino y esperando paquetes ICMP Echo Reply/Response (tipo 0).

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands display the number of bytes transmitted and received via the eth0 network interface? (Choose two.).
questions.explanation: ifconfig eth0 muestra por defecto los contadores RX bytes y TX bytes de la interfaz. Con la herramienta ip , para ver las estadísticas de tráfico en la interfaz se añade el modificador -s ( -stats ): ip -s link show eth0 .

questions.prompt: Given the following routing table:

options.text: It would be passed to the default router 192.168.178.1 on wlan0.
It would be directly transmitted on the device eth0.
It would be passed to the default router 255.255.255.0 on eth0.
It would be passed to the router 192.168.1.1 on eth0.
It would be directly transmitted on the device wlan0.

questions.explanation: La dirección 192.168.2.150 coincide con la regla más específica 192.168.2.0/24 (Genmask 255.255.255.0 ), cuya tercera línea indica que tiene como Gateway el router 192.168.1.1 saliendo por la interfaz eth0 .

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands will delete the default gateway from the system's IP routing table? (Choose two.).
questions.explanation: Para eliminar la ruta por defecto ( 0.0.0.0/0 ), se utiliza route del default con las herramientas net-tools o ip route del default con iproute2 .

questions.prompt: What command enables a network interface according to distribution-specific configuration, such as /etc/network/interfaces or /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/ifcfg-eth0 ? (Specify only the command without any path or paramet ers.).
questions.explanation: El comando ifup lee los archivos de configuración estática propios de la distribución y activa la interfaz indicada conforme a esos parámetros.

questions.prompt: What is true about NetworkManager on a Linux system that uses its distribution's mechanisms to configure network interfaces? (Choose two.).

options.text: NetworkManager reconfigures all network interfaces to use DHCP unless they are specifically managed by NetworkManager.
NetworkManager must be explicitly enabled for each interface it should manage.
NetworkManager by default does not change interfaces which are already configured.
NetworkManager disables all interfaces which were not configured by NetworkManager.
NetworkManager can be configured to use the distribution's network interface configuration.

questions.explanation: NetworkManager cuenta con plugins nativos ( ifupdown para Debian/Ubuntu, ifcfg-rh para RHEL/CentOS) que le permiten leer la configuración de red de la distribución, y por defecto respeta (no desconecta ni altera) las interfaces que ya han sido configuradas externamente ( managed=false ).
